title: Mission: The Soccer Goalkeeper
subtitle: Move into position and protect the goal.
summary: Meet the goalkeeper, learn the goal-area parts, and make a quick save.
activityInstruction: Move the goalkeeper into position to block the shot.

storyQuestions.success: The ball is going toward the goal.

storyQuestions.prompt: Is anyone standing in front of the goal?
storyQuestions.success: No, nobody is standing in front of the goal.
The ball goes into the goal.

storyQuestions.prompt: What do we need to stop the ball?
storyQuestions.success: We need someone to protect the goal.

quiz.prompt: Which part moves toward the goal?
quiz.success: The ball moves toward the goal.

quiz.prompt: Which part catches or blocks the ball?
Which part is the target behind the goalkeeper?
quiz.success: The goal net is the target.

quiz.prompt: What should you do before a shot?
quiz.success: Move into position to make a save.

parts.label: Goalkeeper
parts.fact: The goalkeeper watches the ball and moves across the goal to make a save.
parts.help: The player standing in front of the net.

parts.label: Goal Net
parts.fact: The goal net catches a ball when it gets past the goalkeeper.

parts.label: Ball
parts.fact: The ball travels toward the goal, and the goalkeeper tries to stop it.
parts.help: The round soccer ball near the goal.
